acceptance_condition: An experiment or corpus-derived argument that compares answer-only exposure against answer-plus-rationale exposure in LLM groups and measures both output diversity and aggregate error, with matched total compute.
rationale: Lorenz shows the collapse happens with zero argumentative content in humans; Choi et al. 2025 examine persuasion in debate. Which channel dominates in LLMs determines whether retrieval-mediated staging should gate exposure volume (how many peer answers are seen) or exposure content (rationales vs bare answers) — these imply different designs and different predictions for D5.
text: In LLM ensembles under matched compute, does diversity collapse arise from mere exposure to peers' final answers (Lorenz-style scalar feedback) or does it require exposure to peers' reasoning/justifications?
